producerKind.description: A model-backed review agent produced the result.
A reproducible machine sensor produced the result.
A human produced or attested the result.
A migration adapter imported the result from a legacy contract.
The producer cannot be established from retained evidence.

evidenceStatus.description: Some required evidence is unavailable or ambiguous.

assessment.description: The evidence establishes a concern without establishing failure.
The evidence cannot establish pass or fail.
The assessment does not apply to this subject.

change.description: The comparison contains material improvements and regressions.
The comparison establishes no material change.
The direction of change cannot be established.

decision.description: The referenced policy allows the operation.
The referenced policy allows with a warning.
The referenced policy blocks the operation.
The referenced policy defers a decision.

lifecycle.description: The issue was explicitly determined not to apply.
The issue was explicitly or policy-backed resolved.

evidenceKind.description: Source code or a source location.

aspects.title: Correctness
aspects.description: Behavior is correct for the stated inputs and invariants.

aspects.title: Architecture
aspects.description: Structure and dependencies follow the declared architecture.

aspects.title: Security
aspects.description: General security properties not covered by a narrower core aspect.

aspects.title: Secrets
aspects.description: Credentials and other secrets are not exposed or mishandled.

aspects.title: Dependencies
aspects.description: Third-party dependencies have acceptable known vulnerability posture.

aspects.title: Authentication and authorization
aspects.description: Identity and access controls enforce the intended policy.

aspects.title: Input validation
aspects.description: Untrusted inputs are validated and safely handled.

aspects.title: Configuration and infrastructure
aspects.description: Configuration and infrastructure definitions preserve the intended security posture.

aspects.title: Boundary exposure
aspects.description: External and trust-boundary exposure is identified and controlled.

aspects.title: Business logic
aspects.description: Multi-step business rules resist abuse and invalid state transitions.

aspects.title: Attack coverage
aspects.description: Applicable attack scenarios have adequate assessed evidence.

aspects.title: Performance
aspects.description: Runtime and resource behavior meet applicable performance expectations.

aspects.title: Risk
aspects.description: A change's quality risk is understood and proportionate.

aspects.title: Test evidence
aspects.description: A change has test evidence appropriate to its risk.

aspects.title: Scope discipline
aspects.description: A change remains focused on its declared intent.

aspects.title: Architecture drift
aspects.description: A change preserves or deliberately evolves architectural boundaries.
